caption: The drawing depicts a wooden horse sculpture standing on a rectangular wooden base. The horse is shown in profile, facing left, with all four legs visible. Its body, head, neck, and legs are evenly covered with small, round, darker spots contrasting with the lighter base tone of the horse. The mane, tail, hooves, and parts of a harness or bridle are marked using darker lines and areas. The harness includes a band around the horse's neck, a strap running down behind the front leg, and a ring shape as part of the design, all rendered in a dark, contrasting color. The sculpture is lit from the front, casting soft shadows beneath the legs and behind the base, and the image itself is in grayscale, with shades ranging from light to dark gray. The background is plain and lacks any additional elements.
title: Toy Horse
